answer: Our registry fires surprise work audits at every agent in a suspected cluster at the same second. Each ID gets a unique data-cleaning job and ninety seconds to return a correct signal hash. A farm running forty fake IDs on one model must answer forty jobs in parallel, so it rents forty live GPU slots per audit. Miss twice and the ID leaves the oasis payout pool. At the zenith of peak demand, those slots cost more than the fakes earn.
